messages:
Ava (PM): hi all — want to lock a time for the design review huddle for the new API/SDK/Console changes. thinking 45 min. options: Wed 11:00 PT or Thu 15:00 PT. Pre-read checklist below — please claim an owner and drop links. react with :one: or :two: for times.
Leo (Eng): :one: works for me. can someone add the API openapi spec link? also would like to set perf targets so infra can validate.
Riya (Design): :two: is better for me but can flex. putting the console mock links here: https://redwood.internal/designs/console-new-flows
Please include acceptance criteria for the dialog flows (error states + empty states).
Sam (Infra): thumbs up. for perf we need: 95th p95 < 200ms for small responses, and token-rate goal for streaming. i'll own the telemetry checklist.

Mia (SDK): i can own the SDK pre-read (samples + quickstart). i'll add a small repo branch and a markdown with example usage. planning to include a minimal snippet and install notes.

Ava (PM): owners so far — Mia: SDK samples, Leo: API spec + migration notes, Riya: console mocks + acceptance criteria, Sam: perf/telemetry. Priya, can you own QA smoke tests?

Priya (QA): yep i'll draft a smoke test checklist (happy-path, offline fallback, auth errors). will mock curl samples too.

Leo (Eng): agenda suggestion (45m):
- 5m context + goals
- 15m API surface & compatibility notes
- 10m SDK usage patterns & demo
- 10m Console UX walkthrough
- 5m rollouts/fallbacks + action items

Riya (Design): adding one ask — we should call out where Console will show deprecation warnings and the exact copy. putting a quick draft in the design doc.

Mia (SDK): pre-read links i'll add by EOD: https://redwood.internal/sdk/branches/feature/new-api-samples
snippet:
```bash
# install
pip install redwood-sdk-preview
# quick run
python -c "from redwood import Client; c=Client(); print(c.generate('hello'))"
```

Sam (Infra): Mia — can you include a sample of long-running stream behavior? i need to test KV cache behaviour in the staging cluster.

Mia (SDK): yup will include streaming sample and note on default timeouts.

Ava (PM): quick pre-read checklist (please confirm done in the doc):
- one-paragraph context + business goal
- API spec link + backward-compat notes
- SDK quickstart + example usage (sync + streaming)
- Console mockups + acceptance criteria
- Perf targets + telemetry spec
- QA smoke test checklist
- Rollout plan + rollback criteria

Leo (Eng): can we get docs into the /design-review folder by EOD tomorrow so reviewers have 24h to scan?

Ava (PM): yes — target EOD tomorrow. final call — react to this thread with :one: for Wed 11:00 PT or :two: for Thu 15:00 PT and put your owner initials next to checklist items you take.

Riya (Design): :two: — Riya taking acceptance criteria.

Mia (SDK): :one: — Mia for SDK samples.

Sam (Infra): :one: — Sam for perf/telemetry.

Leo (Eng): :one: — Leo for API spec.

Priya (QA): :two: — Priya for QA checklist.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Design review — API/SDK/Console" Thu 15:00 PT (video link: https://meet.redwood/internal/abc123) — attendees: Ava, Leo, Riya, Sam, Mia, Priya

Ava (PM): thanks — i'll post the final pre-read bundle here when all links are up. please ask if you need extra context ahead of review. :seedling:
